summary: Iteration 10 — verified all 3 Architect P0 directives end-to-end. (1) Publish webhook surfaces 404 + diagnostic hint correctly; (2) SSE syllabus streaming emits start/progress/module/done with real-time heartbeats (counter increments live in UI from 0s..6s..N s and 6 modules render); (3) all enrollment CTAs route to https://learnforge-core.vercel.app/signup?course=...&ref=radar&tier=... with NO /en/, /courses/, or /scrolls/ sub-paths.
backend_tested: GET /api/signals/{id}/publish/preview — CTA URL shape clean (paid_url, free_url, lead_magnet.url all /signup?course=...&ref=radar&tier=...)
POST /api/signals/{id}/publish — returns ok=false, status_code=404, hint contains '/api/courses' and 'not deployed', payload CTAs clean

GET /api/signals/{id}/syllabus/stream (SSE) — Content-Type=text/event-stream; counts via curl: start=1, progress=23, module=6, done=1, heartbeats=23 over ~24s; UI counter increments in real time (0s→6s observed during the 6.4s sampling window)
frontend_tested: ConversionPanel CTA copy buttons: free → https://learnforge-core.vercel.app/signup?course=the-mbb-case-cheat-sheet&ref=radar&tier=free; paid → https://learnforge-core.vercel.app/signup?course=forgecore-mbb-case-mastery&ref=radar&tier=forgecore
CTAPreview anchors: Enroll in ForgeCore + Grab the Free Drop both href = /signup?course=...&tier=forgecore|free

publish-to-learnforge-btn click → publish-result-panel renders red 'WEBHOOK FAILED' banner, HTTP 404, amber DEBUG hint mentioning '/api/courses route is not deployed yet', response body {"detail":"Not Found"}, and COPY PAYLOAD button

trigger-syllabus-btn click → label transitions from 'STREAM LEARNFORGE SYLLABUS (CLAUDE 4.5)' to 'CLAUDE SYNTHESIZING… 0S' within <1s and increments live (1S,2S,3S,4S,5S,6S observed); modules render into syllabus-modules-list after ~25s
infra_observations: Cloudflare edge rewrites Cache-Control on the SSE response from 'no-cache, no-transform' to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' and strips X-Accel-Buffering from the visible headers. SSE still streams in real time (verified via curl and via UI counter incrementing), so this is cosmetic — the no-store directive is at least as strong as no-cache. No action needed unless a stricter proxy is added downstream.
critical_code_review_comments: stream_syllabus correctly busts proxy buffering with the 2KB padding comment + 1s heartbeat ticks while shielding the LLM task — robust against ingress buffering.
publisher._signup_url is a single source of truth for all 3 CTA flavors (paid/free/lead_magnet) — good DRY refactor; matches frontend lib/learnforge.js withRef helper.
Existing Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warning on initial 1920×1080 render is benign (already noted in iteration_9); chart settles correctly.
